status: Territory-perpetual source prepared; Company/effective-date field deletion and Creator promotion require the owner handoff. Historical exports retain the pre-removal schema.

userAccessAddition.helpText: Allows shared approval policies to assign this person to a step. Off blocks routing even when their role assignment is active. Notifications use Approver Email. This does not grant budget editing or approval override permissions.

steps: Ordered steps JSON belongs to one editable policy; submitted routes retain immutable recipient snapshots and existing execution decisions

confirmedPurchaseOrderRules.defaultChain: CFO without new budget modifications; VP then CFO then COO when submission creates attached budget modifications
confirmedPurchaseOrderRules.cooCondition: The server's new budget modification plan is nonempty; pending modification credits retain their existing calculation
confirmedPurchaseOrderRules.vpSource: Exactly one current User_Access identity in the matching Territory.VP; no separate VP role assignment for POs
confirmedPurchaseOrderRules.scope: Territory and Department only, with an all-territory/all-department default; Company does not participate in approval configuration
confirmedPurchaseOrderRules.overrideAuthority: Tentative super administrators/CFO; no new override grant

windows: None. Assignments and rules persist until changed or disabled; approval effective-date fields are deleted.
activation: Adapter_Enabled defaults false and is not writable through this administration API until native workflow regressions and recipient tests pass
reassign: Blocked pending explicit authority and native execution adapter; no silent route edits
